name: FAR-SEA1-the-haze-scales-the-ramp-again
old: return min(min(ramp, hold) + (1.0 - hold) * smoothstep(rimStart, rimEnd, d), 1.0);
new: return min(hold * ramp + (1.0 - hold) * smoothstep(rimStart, rimEnd, d), 1.0);

name: FAR-SEA1-the-sea-fresnel-cap-drifts
old: float seaFresnel(float ndv, float f0) { return f0 + (0.85 - f0) * pow(1.0 - clamp(ndv, 0.0, 1.0), 5.0); }
new: float seaFresnel(float ndv, float f0) { return f0 + (0.8 - f0) * pow(1.0 - clamp(ndv, 0.0, 1.0), 5.0); }

name: FAR-SEA1-a-coast-cell-fills
old: if (!(sea[i0] && sea[i0 + 1] && sea[i0 + side] && sea[i0 + side + 1])) continue;
new: if (!(sea[i0] || sea[i0 + 1] || sea[i0 + side] || sea[i0 + side + 1])) continue;

name: FAR-SEA1-the-fill-spills-past-the-hole
old: if (px < holeX - holeRadius || px > holeX + holeRadius - 1 || py < holeY - holeRadius || py > holeY + holeRadius - 1) return false;
new: if (px < holeX - holeRadius || px > holeX + holeRadius || py < holeY - holeRadius || py > holeY + holeRadius - 1) return false;

name: FAR-SEA1-the-haze-outlives-its-frame
old: this._seaHaze[0] = 0;   // FAR-SEA1: and so is the far ring's haze on the sea
new: // this._seaHaze[0] = 0;   // FAR-SEA1: and so is the far ring's haze on the sea

name: FAR-SEA1-the-lane-ring-sea-loses-its-sky
old: if (sea > 0.0) shown = mix(shown, ringSea(uSeaAmbient, uSeaSunColor, uSeaMoonColor, sun), sea);
new: if (sea > 0.0) shown = mix(shown, shown + 0.0 * ringSea(uSeaAmbient, uSeaSunColor, uSeaMoonColor, sun), sea);

name: FAR-SEA1-the-classic-ring-sea-loses-its-sky
old: if (sea > 0.0) lit = mix(lit, ringSea(uAmbient, uSunColor, uMoonColor, sun), sea);
new: if (sea > 0.0) lit = mix(lit, lit + 0.0 * ringSea(uAmbient, uSunColor, uMoonColor, sun), sea);
